title: Provincial Palace

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped Palacete Provincial building and its connected rear wing.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain at the plaza-side path outside the middle of the long public frontage.

identities.name: Provincial Palace
identities.address: Praça Heliodoro Balbi, Centro, Manaus, Amazonas

mapIdentity.scope: Native OSM building outline, measured terrain, the dated Filipe Fidanza plate, and published government documentation of the restored building.

note: The long masonry frontage is two main storeys above an exposed ventilated plinth, with tall rounded windows, cream pilaster and cornice bands, a central balcony, and roof behind a parapet. The historic side and rear returns descend toward Avenida Floriano Peixoto.
